## Change

What problem does this solve, and what changes for users?

## Validation

Describe what you checked and any limitations. For repository changes, run
`pnpm check`, `pnpm build` and `pnpm test` in that order. Include a screenshot or
example output when it helps review the change.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Generated files came from their documented inputs; skill edits are in root `skills/`.
- [ ] Commits are signed off with `git commit -s`.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/cueframe-ai/cueframe-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
